headline: You called it a quick question, but it was an INTERRUPT. I dropped everything, handled the urgent signal, and never quite restored my previous state.
caption:
You called it a quick question, but it was an INTERRUPT. I dropped everything, handled the urgent signal, and never quite restored my previous state.

—
INTERRUPT: a signal that makes the processor drop what it is doing to deal with something urgent.
